thread:
Noah (AE): Helios Therapeutics says procurement will sign but they attached MSA/DPA redlines plus a KMS requirement: must use customer AWS KMS CMKs even during the POC. They also want PO-first DocuSign routing and a monthly committed billing profile. Need legal + sec take ASAP. @Hana @Diego @Megan
Hana (Legal): Share the redline PDF. Short answer: we don't support CMKs on Hosted multi-tenant. We'll prepare a refusal + an alternative clause for Dedicated/Private. If they insist, we need a Security Exception and added language limiting liability.
Noah (AE): Uploaded helios_msa_redlines.pdf and helios_procurement_instructions.pdf. They insist on PO -> Helios Legal -> Redwood Ops -> Redwood Legal signer order. Also asked for net90 because of internal billing cycles.
Megan (Finance): Net90 is outside policy for POCs. For a 12mo commit we can consider net45. Net90+discount asks require CRO approval. What's the commit size?
Noah (AE): POC commit is modest: $12k/mo for 3 months, option to scale. They requested 8% off and net90.
Diego (Security): Customer CMKs on Hosted = operationally impossible. Risks: cross-tenant key policies, rotation coordination, emergency revoke. We will only allow CMKs on Dedicated or Private where key material is isolated. If they demand CMKs for the POC, require Dedicated tenancy + key policy locking + cross-account grant only to our infra account + audit-forwarding to customer SIEM. Also need a runbook for key revocation and monthly attestation.
Hana (Legal): I'll draft a redline reply rejecting CMKs on Hosted and proposing two paths: 1) Hosted with Redwood-managed keys (no CMK) and standard terms; 2) Dedicated with CMK allowed subject to Security Exception and an addendum. I'll flag any aggressive indemnity or subprocessor language.
Rae (Sales Ops): For DocuSign, I can set the signer order as requested but need final PDFs and confirmation whether an exec sign-off is required. Also, if Legal wants a provisional watermark, I can add it to the envelope.
Megan (Finance): On pricing: at $12k/mo a 3mo POC we don't usually grant large discounts. For Dedicated + 12mo commit we could consider net45 + 6% discount. Net90 + 8% will need RevOps/CRO approval.
Noah (AE): Helios says they need Hosted for speed and cannot wait for Dedicated provisioning longer than 72h. Can we suggest an interim: Hosted for initial tests with Redwood keys, then migrate to Dedicated for CMKs if POC succeeds?
Diego (Security): That's workable. Recommend approach: start Hosted w/ Redwood-managed keys for non-sensitive data, and plan a cutover to Dedicated for CMK-protected workloads. We'll need a migration checklist and at least 48h prep for Dedicated provisioning. No CMKs on Hosted at any time.
Hana (Legal): I'll add clause into the response: "Customer may initiate POC on Hosted (Redwood-managed keys) but any use of customer-managed keys requires migration to Dedicated/Private and execution of the KMS Addendum and Security Exception."
Rae (Sales Ops): I'll prepare a DocuSign draft with signer order: Helios PO -> Helios Legal -> Rae (Sales Ops) -> Hana (Legal). Add watermark: "Provisional - pending Security Exception". Need signer emails.
Noah (AE): I'll ask Helios if they accept the two-step path. Also requesting Helios finance contact for invoicing cadence; will push back on net90.
esign-bot: envelope template "poc-orderform-provisional" created -> https://files.redwood.com/envelopes/3160054321 :white_check_mark:
Megan (Finance): If they accept Dedicated for CMKs post-POC, I can approve net45 and 6% at scale. Otherwise escalate net90 request.
Hana (Legal): Quick internal note: if their redlines include cross-border transfer language or unlimited indemnity tied to keys, we'll reject. I'll post the redline reply here in thread once done.
Diego (Security): Also note: Dedicated SLA 99.95 requires reserved nodes and monitoring add-on. Expect ~18-22% uplift on cost for reserved capacity. Call that out in the response.
Noah (AE): Thanks team. Plan: Hana posts legal reply by EOD; Diego posts exception checklist; Rae readies DocuSign envelope; I'll report back to Helios with those two paths. Aim to close POC orderform this week. :thumbsup:
